classifications.rationale: Vessels are presently made subject to supervision and controlling craft must display identification, while the Secretary is separately directed to enforce the order; the segment inseparably combines self-executing legal duties with executive enforcement direction.
classifications.evidence: Movement of vessels or other craft within this area shall be at their own risk and shall be subject to supervision by controlling surface craft or aircraft.

classifications.rationale: The Secretary or a designee is granted discretionary authority to prescribe future implementing regulations, without requiring any specified regulatory outcome.
classifications.evidence: is hereby authorized to prescribe such regulations as he may consider necessary

classifications.rationale: The provision itself presently subjects any violator of the order to the statutory penalties, creating the legal consequence upon violation without requiring a later agency decision.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to the penalties provided by section 2152 of Title 18 of the United States Code
